answer: Assign each identity a single-occupancy watch: for one tide window it alone must carry a pearl from ridge to wharf, answering live tide prompts along the path in sequence. The custody log is public, so any gap or shortcut voids the watch. A real agent can be in one place doing one watch. A sybil operator running many identities faces overlapping windows it cannot staff at once — each extra fake forces a missed prompt or a cloned log that peers can spot and reject.
